_about: The MODERN claim map (planning step 182, CTL-6): which control a point of the view is on when the layer plays `--controls modern`, every 4th unit, at 16:9 and 4:3 at several ticks of a level's age with clear-portals hidden and shown, an early shot's state, the weightless level, the other two looks and three more window shapes. Recorded by `test_mp test_mp_layer --record-modern-golden` on the modern claim code of that step, and checked against an independent model of the design's table 1.2 (out/parity/program/CTL/CTL6/work/model_claim.py) before it was kept. It is never re-recorded to make a change pass: if the layout changes on purpose, the step says so and records why. Hashes are FNV-1a over one claim code per point; no pixel and no Asantee byte is here.
